verdict.rationale: Gitea ships a versioned REST API at /api/v1 on every instance, with a machine-readable Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0.3 description, an interactive Swagger UI enabled by default, and an API usage guide covering authentication and pagination; an official go-sdk and the tea CLI build on it. The probe 404s for spec paths on docs.gitea.com do not contradict this, because the spec is served from each instance (live-verified on gitea.com). Missing for 10: a documented deprecation or backward-compatibility policy, and independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
